title: Dreams as Multiversal Portals and The Mall World Connection

classification.theory_summary: Proposes that recurring/shared “Mall World” dreams may be connections to alternate realities or a collective unconscious, referencing Anthony Peake and Jung; asks community if this fits their experiences.
